src/spotify_playlist_sync/config.py.purpose: Central configuration — env loading, source paths, playlist names

src/spotify_playlist_sync/spotify_client.purpose: Spotipy OAuth wrapper and playlist utility functions

src/spotify_playlist_sync/state.py.purpose: SQLite state management for processed folders and added tracks

src/spotify_playlist_sync/folder_scanner.purpose: Walks source directories and parses folder names into track metadata

src/spotify_playlist_sync/matcher.py.purpose: Spotify search with fuzzy matching and confidence scoring

src/spotify_playlist_sync/playlist_manag.purpose: Playlist CRUD — find by name, read tracks, add at top, replace

src/spotify_playlist_sync/cli.py.purpose: CLI entry point — scan, review, add, status, rescan, auth commands

sessions.summary: Initial build — all core modules, folder scanner tested (231/234 folders parsed)
Bootstrap + OAuth — context files created, git repo initialized, fixed Spotify credentials, completed OAuth auth

decisions.decision: Reuse track-release-pipeline's file_parser instead of duplicating parsing logic
decisions.reason: Already handles all folder naming patterns correctly

decisions.decision: Use Spotify popularity score (0-100) instead of exact stream counts for Top 10 ranking
decisions.reason: Stream counts require Spotify for Artists access; popularity score is available via standard API

decisions.decision: Load Spotify credentials from MCP server .env as single source of truth
